From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-12T15:30:00Z
Subject: Acme POC — Post-call recap & next steps

Alex — thanks for a productive call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before kickoff.

Pain points you shared:
- Inconsistent prompt quality across user segments (enterprise vs self-serve).
- High per-token costs at peak loads, impacting unit economics for synchronous features.
- Need for strict data controls (VPC + KMS) given regulated EU customers coming online.

Goals for the POC:
1) Reduce median latency for chat flows from ~420ms to <250ms for common prompts.
2) Improve first-pass quality on intent classification prompts (target +6% accuracy uplift).
3) Demonstrate a 20-30% effective token-cost reduction via caching/batching and recommended quantization.

Proposed POC scope (2 weeks):
- Test set: 300 representative prompts (attached acme-eval-promptset.csv).
- Metrics: median latency, p95 latency, accuracy on labeled eval set, tokens per session, cost per 1k queries.
- Model variants: redwood-v1-large (fp16) and redwood-v1-large-quant (4-bit).
- Integrations: sandbox API key + sample dataset upload; we’ll run 1,000 synthetic sessions to simulate peak behavior.

Owners & timeline:
- Redwood: Marissa (AE) — program lead, Aditya (Infra eng) — env/setup, Neha (Solutions) — prompt tuning & evals.
- Acme: Alex — product lead, Morgan — procurement/legal contact.
- Timeline:
  * Today (9/12): Confirm scope & deliverables (this email).
  * 9/13: Redwood to share sandbox keys, access steps, initial config.
  * 9/14-9/18: Run evaluation & tuning.
  * 9/19: Demo + results + recommendations.

Access/setup notes (what we need from Acme):
- Sandbox IP allowlist or temporary creds for our test runner (see redwood-access-guide.txt).
- Sample prompt sets & 10-20 labeled examples for accuracy baseline.

Attachments: poc-scope-v1.pdf (scope & SOW), redwood-access-guide.txt (access steps), acme-eval-promptset.csv (initial prompts).

Please reply with any corrections to scope or owners. If this looks good I’ll schedule the kickoff for Monday 9/13 and loop in Aditya and Neha to start provisioning.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
